description: A generous 135 sqm family apartment with three bedrooms and two bathrooms, designed around a very large open-plan living and kitchen area of 44 sqm. The kitchen is fully integrated into the living space with no dividing wall, so the person cooking is always part of the group — ideal for a parent who wants to prepare meals while supervising children playing, or for someone who loves hosting dinner parties and hates being separated from guests. The three bedrooms vary in size: one large master bedroom of 27 sqm suited to a couple, and two medium bedrooms of around 15 sqm each, perfect for two children or a child and a home office. The two bathrooms prevent morning bottleneck — one can serve the master bedroom, the other the rest of the household. A central corridor connects the private bedroom wing to the shared living zone, creating a clear separation between the quiet sleeping area and the active social spaces. The two facade sides bring natural light into the living area and at least one bedroom. This layout suits a family of three to four people, particularly a couple with one or two children aged school-age or younger, where the parent's visibility over the living area from the kitchen is a daily priority. It also works well for a couple who frequently entertain and need a spare bedroom for guests.
